baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive speech qila governs tamatta'u and is closed by hatta hinin.
baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered directive grants continued benefit while assigning that benefit a terminus; permission and countdown are one act.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the performative opening of the allowance.
Preserved life and delayed enjoyment supply the substance of the temporary grant.
Assigning a time to an act supplies the grant's terminating boundary.

changed_reading.before: An instruction to enjoy for an unspecified while.
changed_reading.after: A speech act allocates continued use of life only inside an assigned interval.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Tamatta'u hatta hinin joins extension to an endpoint-bearing hīn.
baseline_models.mechanism: The enjoyment extends toward its utmost reach, while hīn keeps destruction or death live as the identity of that reach.

activation_trace.role: Extension that reaches its limit turns enjoyment into a terminal arc rather than static pleasure.
The possible arrival of destruction identifies the interval's limit as an event, not merely a date.
Waiting for the moment gives the extension an active countdown.

changed_reading.before: A neutral span of enjoyment that happens to end later.
changed_reading.after: An extension pushed to its limit, with the limit itself carrying the live possibility of destruction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Tamatta'u can denote practical use, and hīn can frame temporary residence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Enjoyment is use of what answers present needs during a bounded stay, so the command concerns usufruct rather than ownership.

activation_trace.role: Useful goods and provisions turn enjoyment into practical use for present needs.
Residence for a time supplies the temporary-tenancy frame for that use.

changed_reading.after: Use the goods of a temporary stay without mistaking access for possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding Moses unit combines dispatch, compelling authority, and disclosure, making the focus passive speech sound like delivered notice rather than casual permission.

activation_trace.role: The spoken directive remains the focus anchor whose institutional force is being revised.
Granted delay supplies the content formally conveyed by the notice.
Message-bearing dispatch supplies an official transmission frame for qila.
Compelling proof supplies the notice with authority beyond the speaker's bare voice.
Disclosure through speech or sign makes the communicated boundary manifest.

structural_cues: 51:38 places sending, authority, and manifest clarity in one clause before the parallel wa-fi destruction units.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sent message, compelling proof, and disclosure; I transfer their official force to the analogous qila, while the live alternative is that they characterize only Moses's sign.

changed_reading.before: An anonymous voice permits a short enjoyment.
changed_reading.after: An authorized notice formally grants and delimits the remaining interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent barren wind leaves no thing untouched but converts it into decay; against mata' as useful goods, enjoyment becomes a last-use phase before utility is materially reversed.

activation_trace.role: Useful goods anchor the changed reading in the practical content of tamatta'u.
A destructive terminus makes material usability explicitly reversible.
Moving wind supplies the material agent that crosses and alters the usable field.
The barren wind removes productive outcome from that material agent.
Leaving nothing supplies the exhaustive scope of the loss of use.
Changing a thing into a state supplies the directional conversion from utility to ruin.
Decay supplies the unusable terminal state of formerly serviceable things.

structural_cues: 51:41-42 immediately precedes 51:43 and uses the same wa-fi exemplum form while ending with total material decay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a barren agent, exhaustive contact, conversion, and decay; I apply that material sequence analogically to mata', while the alternative is that it belongs only to the preceding Aad event.

changed_reading.before: Use available goods until the allotted time expires.
changed_reading.after: The goods themselves occupy a last usable state before the material field can be converted into remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interval closes in defiance, seizure, and a witnessed shock, after which standing capacity and aid disappear; enjoyment is therefore revocable agency, not secure possession.

activation_trace.role: Continued life under delay anchors the temporary availability of agency.
Awaiting the moment turns the grant into a watched cutoff.
Departure from obedience supplies the conduct occurring inside the granted interval.
Seizure supplies the abrupt mechanism that ends control of the interval.
Stunning or death supplies the bodily state at the cutoff.
Directed sight makes the terminal event witnessed rather than hidden.
Waiting and granted delay overlay sight with the temporal logic of hatta hinin.
Capacity supplies the faculty explicitly withdrawn after the cutoff.
Bodily standing gives the loss of agency a concrete posture.
Aid and manifested support supply the external capacity that also fails.

structural_cues: 51:44-45 is the direct continuation of 51:43: defiance, seizure while looking, then inability to stand or receive aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence from defiance to witnessed seizure to lost capacity; I treat hīn as the boundary where agency is withdrawn, while it could instead be only chronological succession without calibrated revocability.

changed_reading.before: They may enjoy until punishment happens.
changed_reading.after: They hold a revocable window of agency; at the watched cutoff, use, posture, and rescue collapse together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-judgment sequence presents built and expanded overhead space with a spread and prepared ground, recasting mata' as use of furnished infrastructure during a temporary habitation.

activation_trace.role: Useful equipment anchors enjoyment as practical access to a furnished environment.
Temporary residence supplies the tenancy limit on environmental use.
Construction by joining parts supplies the environment with built rather than self-owned structure.
Supporting strength supplies the external power sustaining the habitation.
Spatial expansion supplies room within which temporary use occurs.
Spreading and preparing the ground supplies the furnishing action.
Good condition supplies the environment's beneficial usability without implying ownership.
A prepared resting surface completes the temporary-habitation mechanism.

structural_cues: 51:47-48 shifts from failed human standing to a sustained overhead structure and prepared ground.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, support, expansion, spreading, and preparation; I infer a use-right or tenancy relation for mata', while the alternative is a general creation hymn unrelated to the Thamud allowance.

changed_reading.before: Enjoy pleasures during a punitive delay.
changed_reading.after: Exercise temporary use of a furnished habitation whose sustaining infrastructure is not yours.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later imperative to flee toward God and the clear warning give a direction of response inside finite time, so the focus delay can remain punitive while also functioning as an actionable warning window.

activation_trace.role: Continued life and delay anchor the remaining opportunity for response.
Tracking the awaited moment makes action before the boundary intelligible.
Flight supplies a concrete directional response rather than passive waiting.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the interval's protective communicative function.
Clarification by speech or sign makes the required response legible.

structural_cues: 51:50 follows the bounded destruction examples with an imperative of flight and a first-person clear warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, clarity, and a commanded direction; I infer that a finite grant can serve as response time, while the live alternative is that 51:50 addresses only the later audience and does not reopen Thamud's interval.

changed_reading.before: A taunting delay before an unavoidable endpoint.
changed_reading.after: A punitive delay that also exposes a direction of escape while time remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence distinguishes the reminder's reception-dependent benefit from unilateral provision by one who requests no feeding; tamatta'u becomes received and temporary benefit rather than autonomous possession.

activation_trace.role: Enjoyed benefit anchors the comparison between temporary use and another mode of benefit.
Provision for needs anchors the material side of the asymmetrical relation.
A reminder that makes present again supplies the non-material vehicle of benefit.
Benefit opposed to harm explicitly reclassifies what can count as gain.
Heart-settling assent supplies the reception condition for reminder-based benefit.
An apportioned gift supplies the material allotment that is denied as a need of the giver.
Feeding another supplies the rejected reciprocal flow in the provision relation.
Apportioned giving identifies the source of the temporary goods as external to their users.

structural_cues: 51:55-58 moves from beneficial reminder to denial of reciprocal provisioning and then names the provider.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two benefit channels and a one-way provision relation; I contrast both with tamatta'u, while the alternative is that no deliberate lexical comparison with mata' is intended.

changed_reading.before: Enjoyment is a benefit the addressees simply possess.
changed_reading.after: Their enjoyment is a temporary received allotment, while reminder becomes beneficial only through receptive trust and the provider remains independent.

context_deltas.mechanism: An allotted share, prohibition on hastening, severe day, and temporally fixed promise sharpen hīn into a queued and non-accelerable term; the split mapped inventory additionally keeps a counted waiting period live.

activation_trace.role: Granted delay anchors the interval whose measure is sharpened by the closing verses.
Assigning a time supplies the focus term that the later promise specifies.
A share or allotment supplies the distributive logic of each group's coming portion.
Acceleration and bringing forward supply the action explicitly barred from the schedule.
A day's severe event gives the terminus concrete event-density.
Threatening promise supplies the adverse certainty attached to the endpoint.
A promise fixed to time or place turns vague futurity into appointment.
The split-root counted waiting period supplies measured delay without replacing the primary promise sense.

structural_cues: 51:59-60 closes the surah with an allotted analogue, refusal of haste, and the promised day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allotment, barred acceleration, a severe day, appointment, and a counted-period branch; I infer one scheduling mechanism, while the alternative is that the share concerns only punishment magnitude and the countdown remains unquantified.

changed_reading.before: Enjoyment lasts until a vaguely stated future time.
changed_reading.after: Enjoyment occupies an allotted, non-hastenable waiting period terminating in an adverse appointed day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping and must not translate qila as lifting or departure; it remains packet-licensed and focus-anchored through qila, then gains a concrete check from the immediate loss of standing capacity. Render only as a form-distant mobility resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qila at 51:43, with the last interval of tamatta'u followed by inability to stand in 51:45.

activation_trace.role: Carrying, rising, and departing supply a form-distant mobility affordance inside qila's split inventory.
Continued life under delay supplies the last interval in which movement remains possible.
Capacity supplies the faculty whose withdrawal contains the mobility echo.
Standing supplies the explicit bodily motion that becomes impossible.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the utterance marks the last interval in which they can still carry themselves or depart before standing becomes impossible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the race-respite branch is distant from al-matin's local adjective and cannot define it; it remains valid as a branch-backed temporal analogy anchored in extension, waiting, and the following ban on haste. Render as pacing imagery, not lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tamatta'u hatta hinin as an extended but awaited interval.

activation_trace.role: Extension toward a limit supplies the course over which the pacing analogy operates.
Waiting for the moment supplies the held endpoint of the course.
Respite granted in a race supplies the surprising model of a paced lead rather than idle delay.
Acceleration supplies the motion explicitly disallowed, keeping the endpoint externally paced.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a paced interval like a granted lead whose externally set endpoint cannot be accelerated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats repeated speech as a social mechanism rather than only parallel wording; it remains anchored in focus qila and in the later recurrence of messenger, saying, dismissive labels, and queried mutual bequest. Do not claim actual coordination, since 51:53 replaces that possibility with shared transgression.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive qila lahum in 51:43 as one speech event inside the surah's repeated saying pattern.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people opens a social rather than merely individual frame for qila.
Repeated messenger-bearing transmission supplies the incoming side of the speech network.
A saying repeated across peoples supplies the network's recurring counter-speech.
The deception label supplies one stable template for neutralizing the message.
Covered reason supplies the alternate label used to dismiss the message-bearer.
Mutual bequest supplies the explicitly tested hypothesis of coordinated transmission.
Shared transgression beyond the limit replaces coordination as the reproducing condition.

changed_reading.before: One isolated command delivered to one people.
changed_reading.after: A node in a recurrent speech economy where warnings arrive and shared transgression reproduces the same dismissive counter-labels without requiring coordination.

strongest_changes: The passive saying became an authorized act that grants and schedules the remaining interval.
Enjoyment became revocable agency and temporary use of a material field that can be furnished, withdrawn, or converted into remains.
The closing share, ban on haste, and promised day sharpened hīn into an allotted and non-accelerable term, while the warning sequence kept a response path live.
summary.what_was_special: Mata' sustained several non-collapsible readings: life-extension, last-use material utility, furnished tenancy, and dependent provision. Split mapped branches also exposed contained mobility and race-pacing resonances, while repeated qawl supported a social counter-speech model.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the flight command in 51:50 retroactively exposes an escape function in Thamud's interval or addresses only the later audience.
How strongly the furnishing sequence in 51:47-48 and the Aad material reversal in 51:41-42 should attach to the Thamud command rather than remain adjacent contrasts.
The q-l-l mobility and m-t-n race branches remain analogical activators and must not be promoted to lexical renderings.
